card.text: The Large Magellanic Cloud is a dwarf galaxy orbiting the Milky Way, about 49,600 parsecs away.

sources.label: Pietrzyński et al. (2019), Nature 567, 200: a distance to the Large Magellanic Cloud that is precise to one per cent
sources.locator: Distance: 49.59 kpc

introduction.text: Its stars, gas and dust are placed from catalogues on its measured warped disc, and their colors are graded to the image you select.
